title: MIPI I3C target: legacy I2C register access on static address 0x3C (16 x 8-bit registers), ENTDAA dynamic address assignment with arbitration, RSTDAA, GETPID, and in-band interrupts

fields.desc: write 1: request an in-band interrupt carrying IBI.ibi_data; held until a dynamic address is assigned and the bus is idle, kept after a NACK, dropped after a lost arbitration
the IBI data byte (read when the IBI goes out)
a dynamic address is assigned (cleared by RSTDAA)

irqs.name: PROTO
irqs.desc: protocol error or IBI arbitration lost: register pointer out of range, unknown CCC, 7E/R outside ENTDAA, ENTDAA parity error, lost IBI. Held in the core until the next START, so the bit is set again on every clock until then

notes: scl (in) and sda (open drain, needs a pull-up) are the I3C bus; they pass through unchanged. SCL phases must last at least three PCLK clocks.
PID 0x0123456789AB, BCR 0x06, DCR 0x5A (core parameter defaults). The 16 registers are reached over the bus only (first written byte = pointer).
